conditional_h1_ordered_channel_solution.anchor: H1 fixed ordered channel index, excluding declared all-zero channel 66; this is not a biological identity claim.
conditional_h1_ordered_channel_solution.conditioning_limit: sigma_min > 1e-8 is a numerical definability check only. It is not a reliability gate; no source-only conditioning threshold or calibration-stability evidence is closed.

cost_contract.mac_claim: NO hardware/MAC equivalence claim until the consumer is integrated and profiled
cost_contract.numerical_identifiability_gate: cross-Gram sigma_min > 1e-8 only; not a reliability/conditioning threshold
cost_contract.reliability_gate: NOT_CLOSED: a source-only threshold and calibration-stability validation are required before an accuracy claim
cost_contract.streaming_online_solve: none after carrier cache, decoder-consumer compatibility unverified

gauge_and_fail_closed: deterministic SVD sign convention (largest absolute channel loading; lower index breaks ties)
Procrustes polar factor fixes order/sign/rotation only relative to frozen source reference
require enough support blocks, target rank >= 4, finite values, and numerical full rank of the 4x4 cross-Gram (sigma_min > 1e-8)
dead channel 66 is never normalized or inferred; its output row is zero
conditional_h1_ordered_channel_solution.literature_scope: A-FULL is an H1-only ordered-channel carrier inspired by aligned-factor-analysis/Procrustes geometry. It is not an implementation or reproduction of a published competing adaptation method. In particular, it does not implement NoMAD-style target-time backpropagation or read-in/readout updates, and it does not by itself close the paper limitation that competing adaptation methods have not been implemented.
conditional_h1_ordered_channel_solution.not_general: This is H1-only. It cannot be claimed for variable-N SUA sorted units or RT channels, where index order is not a stable cross-session correspondence.
conditional_h1_ordered_channel_solution.source_only_fit: Fit source mean/scale and [175,4] reference loading basis inside each source-LODO fold only. Reference PCA is block-weighted after per-recording centering: every valid M=4 source block has equal weight, so a recording with more blocks contributes more rows.
conditional_h1_ordered_channel_solution.target_unlabeled_solve: From chronological target support neural rates only, compute target PCA axes; solve 4x4 orthogonal Procrustes against source reference; restore dead channel 66 as literal zero; apply fixed 1/sqrt(175) orthonormal-loading scale (not a source-fitted statistic).

existing_adapter_blocker.reason: The existing target dataset loads velocity through load_record and calls label-supervised fit_frozen_carrier. A compliance run requires a new target neural-only support adapter with a poison behavior/velocity field test before any decoder experiment.
static_evidence: h1_m4_eb_pilot.py: load_record receives neural and velocity; fit_frozen_carrier consumes trial.velocity
h1_carrierid_date_lodo_target.py: target support is first four chronological trials, query begins at fifth trial, and current carrier call is fit_frozen_carrier

generic_cca_or_procrustes.reason: Unpaired source and target neural supports have no common sample/condition correspondence. CCA needs paired observations; Procrustes needs a matched row basis. Behavioral phase, velocity, target labels, or timestamps cannot be introduced without changing the no-label contract.

alternatives: obtain a real cross-session channel/unit correspondence or stable metadata anchor, then preregister it
use matched behavioral/phase anchors and explicitly relabel the method weakly supervised rather than label-free
keep the current source-trained compact-consumer claim and do not create a fictitious generic CCA/Procrustes baseline

A-FULL.carrier: proposed H1 ordered-channel target-neural-only aligned [176,4] carrier

A-FULL@RS.carrier: row-shuffle of proposed target carrier supplied to frozen A-FULL checkpoint
A-FULL@RS.role: same-checkpoint attachment-sensitivity diagnostic only; not a trained endpoint control

A-RS.carrier: complete-row-shuffled proposed aligned carrier, shuffle fixed per record/seed

A-Z4.carrier: literal [176,4] zero carrier at the model boundary

H-C.role: matched labeled operational reference, never an alias for A-FULL
H-C.training: existing separately trained labeled reference when all protocol fields match

H-LS/H-RS.training: contextual references only unless data boundary, consumer, seed, checkpoint, normalizer, and source-LODO protocol exactly match

required_future_controls.source_lodo: Every outer target date must fit its source mean/scale and reference basis from source recordings only; the orthonormal carrier scale is a fixed algebraic constant, and no target recording contributes to fitting.
required_future_controls.target_boundary: Target support is the first four chronological trials; query starts at the fifth chronological trial. The new adapter must expose only neural support rates to the alignment solve.
required_future_controls.training_requirement: A-FULL, A-Z4, and A-RS must be separately trained, with identical source-LODO dates, seeds, checkpoint rule, source mean/scale, carrier width, and target support/query boundary. A-FULL@RS is same-checkpoint diagnostic only. H-C is a labeled operational reference only if all fields match; H-LS/H-RS remain contextual unless exact protocol parity is established.
